snippet.title: Introducing... "TextSavvy" with Scott Rogowsky
snippet.description:
** SUBSCRIBE http://goo.gl/rtR3f **

HE'S BAAA-AAACK!!!! After nearly 7 years of famine, the internet can once again feast on the live mobile game show host formerly known as Quiz Daddy...

Scott Rogowsky returns to your phone with a new game that has a new name... introducing TextSavvy on the Savvy mobile app! Download today and come play against Scott and the rest of the world as you race against the clock to solve word puzzles, score points, and maybe even win some cash!

http://playsavvy.live
